annotations.text: P68 — Inventory canvas. Depends on P40, P59. Phase 5 tokens. Overview: search + barcode scan, low-stock alert strip (3 items), KPI tiles (84 SKUs/₹2.6L value/3 low), category tabs, item rows with stock bars (LOW/OK badges). Stock Adjustment: item selector with alert, Add/Remove/Reorder action chips, big qty stepper, reason chips, live preview (before/after), Olive Green CTA.
